answer: The basalt schedule is applied in hollow and prism makes public each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4463 identities would post 2873 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
